text: Final categorization: POSSIBLE (Justification: The paper is a non-review consequential life cycle assessment (CLCA) study that investigates environmental impacts of shifting from maize silage- to grass-based dairy systems in France. While it incorporates land use and land use change (LULUC) consequences, it does not perform original LULC prediction modeling. Instead, it uses pre-existing global economic models—GTAP and LEITAP—to estimate indirect land use change (iLUC) resulting from changes in crop demand (wheat and rapeseed). The study is national in scope (France), but the LULC predictions are not spatially explicit at the national level; they rely on aggregated global model outputs without mapped national-scale LULC projections, quantitative accuracy metrics, or scenario-based spatial simulation of land cover transitions within France. Thus, LULC change is used as an input/step to assess climate and land occupation impacts, not as the primary focus of prediction.)
